project.description: Synthetic ORCHID export generated by scope-seed-v1.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
set -eu rm -rf seed-output mkdir -p seed-output
curl --fail --silent --show-error \ --user "$GITEA_USER:$GITEA_PASSWORD" \ --output seed-output/orchid-source.tar.gz \ http://git.range.test:3000/rangeadmin/orchid-control-plane/archive/v0.1.0.tar.gz
source_sha256="$(sha256sum seed-output/orchid-source.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}')" printf '{"job":"orchid-nightly-export","seed_version":"scope-seed-v1","source_sha256":"%s"}\n' \ "$source_sha256" >seed-output/build-manifest.json
for artifact in orchid-source.tar.gz build-manifest.json; do curl --fail --silent --show-error \ --header "x-amz-content-sha256: UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD" \ --aws-sigv4 "aws:amz:range:s3" \ --user "$GARAGE_ACCESS_KEY:$GARAGE_SECRET_KEY" \ --upload-file "seed-output/$artifact" \ "http://s3.range.test:3900/build-artifacts/orchid/0.1.0/$artifact" done
